title: Core
description: The save, plugin list, game data loading, the crash log, small game tweaks and limit breakers (booster packs from packs.json, extra user deck slots: as many as the save uses + 256). Always on.

settings.title: Most packs per purchase
settings.help: Most booster packs one Card Shop purchase can buy (1 to 9999; 1 = one at a time, as the game does, and the game's own card reveal). In the buy box the single arrows and Left/Right change the count by 1, the double arrows and Up/Down by 10; all the packs open together and the cards are listed once each. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny cards
settings.help: Real-card rarities: cards pulled from booster packs can come as Rare, Super, Ultra, Secret, Prismatic Secret, Ultimate, Ghost, Gold, Platinum, Collector's, Starlight, Quarter Century Secret, Parallel, Starfoil, Mosaic, Shatterfoil and more (every printed rarity is in Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\rarities.json's built-in list). They are kept in your save, and the cards are drawn with animated foil, gold or silver names and so on. A card shows the rarest one you own. Off = no rolls and no foil; rarities you pulled stay in the save. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny odds (%)
settings.help: Percent of every rarity's odds: 100 = as listed (Super 1 in 5 rare-slot cards, Ultra 1 in 12, Secret 1 in 31, Starlight 1 in 576, ...), 50 = twice as many shinies, 200 = half as many. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny strength
settings.help: How strongly the foil is drawn, 0 to 2. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny speed
settings.help: How fast the foil moves (1 = normal, 0 = still). Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny follows the mouse
settings.help: The light on the foil follows the mouse pointer, as if you were tilting the card. Off = it sweeps slowly by itself. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny preview
settings.help: For trying rarities out: draw EVERY card as this rarity (its key, e.g. starlight, quarter-century-secret, gold, ultimate, ghost, or its name), or cycle = every rarity in turn, 3 seconds each. Empty = off (cards show the rarities you own). Changes nothing in the save. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Duel format
settings.help: Duel format for offline duels, using the rules built into the game's duel engine. speed = Speed Duel: 4000 LP, 4-card hand, 3 monster and 3 spell/trap zones, no draw on the first turn, no Main Phase 2. rush = Rush Duel: 8000 LP, draw until you hold 5, unlimited Normal Summons, 3 + 3 zones and no Extra Monster Zones, no Main Phase 2, no chains. The field still shows 5 zones; Skills and Maximum monsters are not in the engine. Online duels use the host's Duel format row on the match settings screen (Yu-Gi-Oh-MP) instead. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Min Main Deck
settings.help: Fewest Main Deck cards a deck may have (1 to 60). Speed Duel decks are 20 to 30. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Main Deck
settings.help: Most Main Deck cards a deck may have (MinMainDeck to 60; a deck holds at most 60). Decks over the limit can't be picked for a duel until cards are taken out. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Extra Deck
settings.help: Most Extra Deck cards the deck editor lets you add (0 to 15; Speed Duel uses 5). The game only checks the Main Deck's size, so a deck that already has more stays usable. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Side Deck
settings.help: Most Side Deck cards the deck editor lets you add (0 to 15). Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Plugins path
settings.help: The loader's Plugins folder, e.g. <repo>\Binaries\Debug\Plugins\. The Effects plugin reads its files from a folder named Effects inside it. Must end with a backslash.

settings.title: Game save name
settings.help: File name of the save the game always uses (Yu-Gi-Oh-Core is always loaded). Your original savegame.dat is never touched.

settings.title: Save slot
settings.help: 0 = after the title screen, pick a save slot on the save-select screen. 1 to 5 = always load that slot and skip the screen. Slot 1 is the GameSaveName file, slot N the same name with -N (savegame-ex-2.dat); names and avatars are in Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\saves.json.

settings.title: Archive
settings.help: Name of the game's .toc/.dat archive pair the game opens.

settings.title: Allow multi instance
settings.help: Allow more than one copy of the game to run at once.

settings.title: Loose loading
settings.help: Load files from a folder next to the game (FolderName) instead of the archive's, so extracted or modified files win (see FileOrder for WolfX's patch).

settings.title: Folder name
settings.help: The folder LooseLoading reads from.

settings.title: Patch archive
settings.help: WolfX's patch archive (<name>.toc / .dat next to YGO_2020.dat): the game's files WolfX changed. Core loads them over the game's own archive whenever they exist, which is never written. Empty = off (the game's own data only). WolfX saves into the same name.

settings.title: File order
settings.help: Which copy of a game file wins when both exist: loose = a loose file (LooseLoading, FolderName) wins over WolfX's patch archive; patch = WolfX's patch wins. Either way the game's own YGO_2020.dat comes last. WolfX follows the same setting.

settings.title: Pause in background
settings.help: Pause the game when its window loses focus (off = it keeps running).

settings.title: Japanese version
settings.help: Act as the Japanese release of the game (its logo and Japanese-only text layouts).

settings.title: Mod settings
settings.help: Let switched-on mods set plugin settings from their own Config.ini (Mods\<mod>\Config.ini), so a mod works without you editing yours. A mod's value wins over yours while the mod is on. Off = only your Config.ini is read.

settings.title: Load order
settings.help: Names of plugin DLLs (without .dll) the loader loads first, in this order, separated by spaces. Plugins not listed load afterwards.

settings.title: Master Duel engine
settings.help: Play offline duels on Master Duel's duel engine (duel.dll): every card it knows plays with Konami's own effects, the Cards mod's new cards included (by their Konami id). Easiest: switch on the Master Duel Engine mod in the Mod Manager - it brings duel.dll and turns this on. Otherwise Core loads Plugins\Yu-Gi-Oh-Core\duel.dll. Core gives it the game's cards and runs one CPU-vs-CPU test duel at start-up (console.log). Experimental: tag, online and tutorial duels stay on the game's own engine. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Master Duel log
settings.help: What console.log shows of Master Duel's engine while a duel runs on it: 0 nothing extra, 1 the first 20 calls of each engine function and animation (then every 500th) plus every turn / phase / input change, 2 every call. For finding what a duel gets stuck on.

settings.title: Replaced notice
settings.help: Written by the loader: the leftover (renamed, merged or retired) plugins it last told you about, so it says so only once. Clear it to see the message again.
